apis.signatures.resolve: compilation, bindings, max_types=1048576 -> Result; signatures only
apis.declaration_checks.check: resolved Result -> Diagnostic; unspecialized declarations only
apis.signature_frontend.load: module frontend + signature resolution + declaration checks

ownership.model: owned snapshot/value semantics; no exposed native pointers
ownership.input: loader/binder-produced valid graph with unchanged AST and edge invariants
ownership.syntax: original annotation indices retained; semantic type IDs are separate
ownership.defaults: owned output graph changes expression kind/text for normalized literal names, retaining coordinates
ownership.type_identity: interned within one pool; nominal records use graph-wide binder declaration IDs; type parameters follow existing name identity
ownership.method_symbols: zero until later body-analysis symbol allocation; parent and method ordinals identify methods
ownership.failure: empty graph/declarations, fresh two-sentinel type pool, located diagnostic; no partial resolved graph or failed-source snapshot

wire.encoding: JSON Lines; default texts and diagnostic messages encoded as lowercase hexadecimal bytes
wire.type_order: child-first, reachable types encountered by return/parameter order; declarations global-first then methods in record/source order
wire.type_ids: zero-based wire pool indices, independent of internal pool allocation order
wire.nominal_identity: one-based binder declaration ID; display names alone are not identities
wire.absent: element/key/parent/method/field=-1 where absent; methods have symbol=0
wire.failure: empty files/types/declarations; source ID refers to discarded graph; use file and coordinates
wire.coordinates: zero-based byte offsets; one-based physical line and byte column; zero for driver errors
